newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy says 1997 average CPI goal will be reached.
newsitem.headline: Italy says 1997 average CPI goal will be reached.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Friday that Italy would hit its average 1997 inflation target of 2.5 percent and achieve 2.0 percent inflation in 1998.
Prodi, in a speech to a congress of the Democratic Party of the Left, the biggest in his centre-left coalition government, said Italy had beaten inflation.
"The goal of 2.5 percent will be reached this year and that of 2.0 percent next year is within reach," he said.
Prodi welcomed preliminary consumer price index data from six sample cities on Thursday which pointed to an inflation rate of 2.2-2.3 percent year-on-year in February.
Five more sample cities report figures later on Friday. -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2501
